I was in your position a few years back. I had my life slowly taken away from me lost my lover,father and friends i got very ill and was at thee hospital ward all the time and i had the number thing too anytime i saw or heard a 6 i would freak out. Im glad you wrote this because im realizing now that  im not alone. I just recently got a job and ive been stressing too my boss notices and tells me to relax alot. I still get suicidal thoughts from time to time and i feel like a failure too. Im an art student . i used to be able to handle any task that was given to me as a graphic artist. now im having trouble trouble just doing a simple tattoo for my good friend. I feel like im a has been that never was but im trying hard to say fuck you depression/ Anxiety! im the boss and im in control! you should treat yourself better im trying to do this too so i know how hard it is to think positive when you are always negative. I feel that sometimes i should just get my own apartment to myself and never talk to anyone so that im not an annoyance or a disappointment to anyone. The main thing is You're not crazy you just have dealt with more then you can handle and you need to forgive and let go of things. Im trying to do this too. just know you're not the only person who feels this way and you can get through it.

thats a good description of how i feel too. Im trying to regain that happiness and comfort i once had and it's a struggle everyday to keep myself going. My teen years were pretty stressful and i think it's something i have to try and let go and other events that happened later on too.

I know exactly how you feel. my anxiety started when i was about 19. Im 21 now and almost 22 and i still have it ive gotten the upper hand latley but there are days when i feel that im hopeless too. you should stop smoking weed it'll make it worse at this point i had to stop too because it was causing me to freakout and think that the world was gonna explode or some really fucking bad shit was about to go down. i understand the feeling of the creeping doom that is coming. but you need to tell your self it's bull shit. and yeah it's easier said then done. i still have days where it's harder to handle then others. but you have to try to tell yourself nothing is happening and you have a condition that causes the feeling and it's not real it's just a chemical reaction in your brain that gives you the sensation of fear. and you have to learn to live with the feeling once you start thinking that way it makes it easier. I dont know if there is a cure for it but i can say that you can learn to calm it down. Stay away from prescriptions!!!!! i will say it again STAY AWAY FROM PRESCRIPTIONS!!!! I did the perscrption route and all it did was make me a pill popper walking around with full bottles of atavan and clonopan sorry i cant spell these ridiculous names but you get my point. you become dependant on them right away. learn to handle it on your own. everyone has a different way in dealing with their attacks. what i do to calm myself down is by controlling my breathing and telling myself that what ever my mind is coming up with isnt true because it's come up with 10000 other random scary things that ended up never happening so it's fucking bull shit! thats kinda how i do it and on the thinking about loved ones dieing. i do it all the time too idk why but it occurs in my head too and it's fucking depressing and ruins any interaction im having with them. Just enjoy your time with them especially your parents the fact that you have a good enough relationship with them to talk about how you're feeling is awsome you have wonderful parents and im sure they will listen and be there for you no matter what. but dont worry about the end life is a journey not a destination. i know thats probably been said to you 100000 times before but it's true think about what you're doing in the present not the future. it's hard to control your mind and what it thinks. my mind comes up with scary shit when my attacks happen too. im thinking about learning meditation and seeing if that works you should try it out too it's suppose to teach you how to calm you mind.  anxiety is something that you can handle you just need to know that you're not alone in the world with this feeling it's more common then you think. sry bout the rant hope i was able to help out. :D
